profile.headline: Software Engineer at Charleston Homes
profile.summary: Driven technology enthusiast with a passion for problem solving and improving business processes through the use of technology. Always eager to learn and have developed the skills to work well with a team as well as independently when necessary through full SDLC. Experience with Java, C, C#, SQL, Perl, and more!

positions.title: Technical Consultant
positions.description:
- Examined existing business processes to improve technical efficiency
- Communicated with clients promptly to achieve core goals
- Documented and trained clients on custom construction estimating solution

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
- Migrated Web Application components from ASP.NET Webforms/Knockout.js to React framework
- Developed in a team environment while remotely peer-programming
- Utilized TDD to exceed client expectations

positions.title: Design Productivity Assistant
positions.description:
Volunteer Position
- Trained users in person on computer fundamentals and proprietary software
- Supported remote users with personal computers and web collaboration framework

company.name: WATCHTOWER BIBLE AND TRACT SOCIETY OF NEW YORK INC

positions.title: A/V Support
positions.description:
- Provided ongoing technical support for distance learning classrooms at the College of Information Technology 
- Operated PTZ cameras and monitored audio quality from control room
